latestVersion.changelog:
Blancpain skill version 1.0.0 — comprehensive reference for the world’s oldest watchmaking brand.

- Covers Blancpain’s uninterrupted mechanical watchmaking since 1735.
- Details the pioneering Fifty Fathoms dive watch and its influence on modern dive watches.
- Explains Blancpain’s philosophy of mechanical-only production and artisanal assembly.
- Summarizes key collections: Fifty Fathoms, Villeret, L-Evolution, and their complications.
- Highlights competitive positioning, heritage, and remarkable facts unique to Blancpain.
